lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spots are most intensely concentrated along the mid-lateral axis, forming a grid-like pattern with roughly equidistant spacing between local maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of higher pixel intensity cross the lateral flank, with the circular high-luminance blobs acting as anchor nodes at the intersection points of these vertical stripes and the horizontal axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges run along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a light-colored dorsal edge and a deep shadowed ventral edge, extending from the branchial region toward the caudal fin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs. These spots are irregularly spaced and significantly smaller than those on the main body flank, primarily located on the anterior half of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small irregular notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin. Multiple remoras are attached to the mid-lateral flank area, causing localized shadows and slight occlusion of the skin pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: The pre-branchial head region exhibits a much higher density of significantly smaller, clustered high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more structured constellation on the posterior flank.
